assessments.name: Final Exam
assessments.description: Final exam comprising of MCQs and short answer questions covering the contents from modules 1, 2 and 3.

assessments.name: Module 1 practical report and assignment
assessments.description: Students will complete the entries in the interactive PDF pathology document provided to them during the "Cancer Pathology" practical session plus 400 words summary of the pathology report following the instructions provided on Canvas.

assessments.name: Mid-semester quiz
assessments.description: MCQs covering the materials from Modules 1 and 2.

assessments.name: Module 2 practical report and assignment
assessments.description: Students will generate a poster presentation based on the contents of the Module practical and practical discussion sessions using the template and instructions provided on Canvas.

assessments.name: Personalised Cancer Therapy student pitch
assessments.description: Groups of 4-5 students will be presenting a 3min pitch and will be assessed in class by an assessment panel.

assessments.name: Module 3 practical report and assignment
assessments.description: Students will generate a flow chart based on teh experimental workflow for the practical session in Module 3, plus a complied figure with annotations and figure legend from the results.
